💡 freecad-mcp | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enable users to design and manipulate 3D models within FreeCAD using natural language commands processed by Claude AI.
✨ Key Features: • FreeCAD MCP server integration • Control FreeCAD from Claude Desktop • Generate 3D models via AI conversation • Supports designing from 2D drawings • Addon installation for FreeCAD
📖 Summary: This repository provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates FreeCAD with Claude Desktop, enabling users to control FreeCAD functionalities and generate 3D models through conversational AI.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 dembrandt | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automate the extraction of design system tokens from existing websites, enabling consistency, auditing, and integration with development workflows and AI tools.
✨ Key Features: • Extracts design system tokens (logo, colors, typography, borders, etc.) from websites. • One-command execution for design token extraction. • Utilizes Playwright for browser automation.
📖 Summary: Dembrandt is a command-line tool that automatically extracts design system tokens (like colors, typography, and borders) from any website. It uses Playwright to drive a browser, allowing for reverse-engineering of design elements into structured data, usable for AI agents and CI/CD pipelines.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 Voice-Clone-Studio | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified and user-friendly web interface for performing a wide range of voice cloning, voice design, and multi-speaker conversation generation tasks by integrating multiple advanced AI voice engines.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-model voice cloning with engines like Qwen3-TTS, VibeVoice, LuxTTS, Chatterbox, and Fish Speech • Automatic transcription support via Whisper, VibeVoice-ASR, and Qwen3-ASR
📖 Summary: Voice Clone Studio is a modular, Gradio-based web UI for advanced voice manipulation tasks. It integrates multiple state-of-the-art engines for voice cloning, voice conversion, multi-speaker conversation generation, and sound effect creation, offering a unified interface for various voice AI technologies.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ kvm | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Remote management of computers, servers, and workstations, including tasks like OS installation, BIOS adjustments, and general remote control.
✨ Key Features: • Ultra-low Latency (1080p@60FPS, 30-60ms) • H.264 encoding • Free & Optional Remote Access via WebRTC • Optional Tailscale Networking support • Open-source software written in Golang on Linux
📖 Summary: JetKVM is an open-source KVM over IP solution written in Go and TypeScript, designed for high-performance remote computer management. It offers ultra-low latency video and smooth input control, with optional cloud and networking integrations.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 scanopy | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically generate and maintain accurate network documentation and visualization, eliminating the need for manual drawing and ensuring the documentation reflects the current state of the infrastructure.
✨ Key Features: • Automatic network discovery and mapping • Multiple documentation views (L2, L3, workloads, applications) • Distributed scanning capabilities • Docker and SNMP integration
📖 Summary: Scanopy is a Rust-based tool that automatically generates up-to-date network documentation by scanning infrastructure. It provides multiple views of the network, including L2, L3, workloads, and applications, replacing static diagrams with a continuously maintained model.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 sandbox | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified, secure, and all-in-one execution environment for AI agents and developers, integrating various tools like browsers, shells, and IDEs within a single Docker container.
✨ Key Features: • All-in-One Agent Sandbox Environment • Combines Browser, Shell, File, MCP, and VSCode Server • Single Docker Container deployment
📖 Summary: AIO Sandbox is a Dockerized, all-in-one environment for AI agents, integrating browser, shell, file operations, VSCode Server, and MCP services into a single, unified platform. It simplifies development and execution by providing a consistent and secure workspace with seamless file sharing across different tools.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
